Definition: Hadad, the name of an idol, and of several kings of Edom
BiblicalUsage: Hadad is the name of an idol, and of several kings of Edom. In Genesis 36:35, the text says "and Hadad the son of Bedad." The life behind the name is told on the Hadad People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadad matters because God knows His people by name, and Hadad is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
